applicationSettings.description: Canonical UTF-8 settings must additionally fit 64 KiB; semantic validation is authoritative.

applicationLaunch.description: Canonical UTF-8 metadata must additionally fit 256 KiB; paths must bind to the declared input tree.

libraryPublication.$comment: Project validation rejects duplicate emitted root or derived target publication coordinates across modules.

documentationSpec.description: Source-set names and roots must be unique; roots cannot overlap; dependency edges must form a closed acyclic graph.

documentationDistribution.description: Semantic validation additionally limits total distribution size to 256 MiB.

scriptDependencyProfile.description: Canonical UTF-8 declaration must fit 256 KiB. Native semantics additionally validate expansion, reference conflicts, path overlaps, prerequisite targets and total expanded bounds.

script.description: Canonical UTF-8 declaration must fit 256 KiB. Native semantics additionally validate expansion, reference conflicts, path overlaps, prerequisite targets and total expanded bounds.

fileTags.description: Manual tags on exact configuration-relative files, additive to derived tags. Absent files and directories are omitted; no glob or recursive matching.

standaloneScript.description: The companion for <stem>.kt is <stem>.kvik.json; durable lock is <stem>.kvik.lock.json. Native validation rejects workspace dependencies/plugins, and the CLI must bind the selected .kt to an explicit source file.

sourceGraphInput.description: Structural source graph contract. Semantic validation must additionally check sorted unique IDs/lists, acyclic reachable dependency closures, exact library order, directory coverage, normalized nonoverlapping paths, UTF-8 byte and aggregate limits, compiler option pairs, and immutable URL consistency. The input parser also rejects duplicate JSON keys and noninteger numeric tokens. A valid document is not evidence that source/artifact bytes have been acquired or verified.

sourceGraphObserved.description: Structural source graph contract. Semantic validation must additionally check sorted unique IDs/lists, acyclic reachable dependency closures, exact library order, directory coverage, normalized nonoverlapping paths, UTF-8 byte and aggregate limits, compiler option pairs, and immutable URL consistency. The input parser also rejects duplicate JSON keys and noninteger numeric tokens. A valid document is not evidence that source/artifact bytes have been acquired or verified.

testAggregate.$comment: Core aggregation verifies contributor report digests, compatible input/tool identities, unique run/check ownership, expected-check partitioning, derived counts/status and provenance bindings. JSON Schema cannot compare check sets, match per-entry report digests or count unique test identities/attempts.

const: Normalized data exposes line states only; original JaCoCo XML retains instruction, branch, method and class counters.

coverageReport.$comment: Kotlin CoverageReport.fromJson additionally verifies exact expected-source membership, source/class-root ownership, consecutive line numbers/counts, distinct manifest paths and XML for every class root. Kotlin text bounds count UTF-16 code units; JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points.

coverageThresholdResult.$comment: The Kotlin contract additionally verifies covered <= executable and the exact integer threshold comparison. Evaluation verifies selected module membership, same-source identity/measurement compatibility and report completeness.

coverageAggregateThresholdPolicy.$comment: Kotlin parsing also rejects repeated target IDs with different policies; serialization sorts targets.

coverageAggregateThresholdResult.$comment: Core evaluation matches targets and policies to the retained aggregate, counts distinct source paths within each target, and performs an exact integer comparison. JSON Schema cannot verify target-ID uniqueness across differing records, policy correspondence, covered <= executable or the comparison arithmetic.

coverageAggregate.$comment: Kotlin CoverageAggregate.fromJson reconstructs the aggregate from scope and canonical contributions, verifies report digests and compatibility, and rejects any contradictory derived fields. JSON Schema cannot verify digest bindings, expected-check partitions, source ownership or line-union arithmetic.

coverageConsumerExportResult.$comment: Core export additionally verifies source/module selection, complete compatible line mappings for Sonar, and original artifact availability for JaCoCo. The files manifest is relative to the report output directory; provenance/status remain in the sidecar. JaCoCo files preserve original bytes, scoped by contributing check and production module.

preparedApplication.description: Canonical UTF-8 descriptor must additionally fit 8 KiB and bind a completed application preparation record.

applicationReady.description: Invocation-local strict canonical JSON, at most 8 KiB UTF-8; Native parsing additionally enforces valid Unicode, UTF-16 path lengths and digest bindings. Started means process-host acceptance, not health or successful exit.

applicationActivation.description: Invocation-local strict canonical JSON, at most 8 KiB UTF-8; Native parsing additionally enforces valid Unicode, UTF-16 path lengths and digest bindings. Started means process-host acceptance, not health or successful exit.

applicationStarted.description: Invocation-local strict canonical JSON, at most 8 KiB UTF-8; Native parsing additionally enforces valid Unicode, UTF-16 path lengths and digest bindings. Started means process-host acceptance, not health or successful exit.

abiWorkerRequest.description: Input paths must belong to the selected JVM directory, or contain exactly the selected Native KLIB; semantic validation binds these paths.

abiSnapshot.description: Exact public API text with LF line endings; semantic validation additionally limits UTF-8 to 8 MiB.

abiComparison.description: Snapshot and baseline paths must be distinct.

abiReady.description: A current candidate is available for review; the run may still fail its baseline comparison.

revisionClaims.description: Claim values are retained JSON text, including unknown JSON types. Canonical UTF-8 metadata must also fit 1 MiB.

sourceView.description: Revision-pinned display projection, not an authorization policy. Files have unique revision-relative paths below source.root, satisfy predicate, and total canonical UTF-8 JSON is at most 16 MiB.

projectFileTagRules.description: Configuration-relative paths, unique within each rule kind; at most 100000 entries combined. Union exact and strict-ancestor descendant tags, default to kind:unclassified if empty, then add manual tags.

sourceRolePolicy.description: Explicit trusted-caller invocation policy, not authentication or sandboxing. Pinned view tags must match rules. Null editable denies all edits; paths outside source.root are denied. Canonical UTF-8 JSON must fit 16 MiB.

kodeRetentionReference.description: Original source pin acquired for a run; not a live-retention or tool-availability claim. Object IDs must use the same width, and project/revision/tree must match the run source provenance.
